_help: Classes. a = starting attributes, w = starting weapon (wt from data/weapons.json), shield = start with a shield, mods = class passive (stat keys, see docs/STATS.md), skills = starting skills (data/skills.json), tunic/cape = colours, start = skill tree start cluster (a class without its own arm in data/skilltree.json starts on that class's arm). 'rogue' is the Ranger id (kept for old saves). F-34: passives = named class passives [{n, d, mods}] (stat stage 'class'); gear = starting gear set {slot: {n, def, hp, mp, dmg}} (names match data/avatar.json so the set is shown); wt 'unarmed' = no weapon item (fists).

paladin.d: Mace, shield and holy light. Smites foes and heals allies.

berserker.d: Greatsword and fury. Hits harder the more hurt you are.

assassin.d: Twin-fast dagger. Crits, poison and vanishing steps.

spellblade.d: Sword and sorcery. Magic feeds the blade.

cleric.d: Mace and miracles. The best healer, steady holy damage.

druid.d: Staff of the wild. Poison, thorns and regrowth.

necromancer.d: Staff of bones. Shadow magic and life drain.

warlock.d: Wand of hexes. Curses that burn and wither.

lancer.d: Spear and reach. Charges, sweeps and launches foes.

warden.d: Axe and shield. Bleeds, taunts and stands firm.

monk.d: Bare fists and chi. Quick strikes, kicks and an iron will.

bard.d: Wand and song. Sonic spells, lullabies and songs that lift the whole party.

passives.d: Everything you do hits a little harder.

shaman.d: Staff of the spirits. Totems, lava, earth and wind.

passives.d: The ancestors turn the elements aside.

samurai.d: Katana and discipline. Lightning draws, sweeping cuts and a fearless shout.

chronomancer.d: Staff of hours. Bends time: slows, stops and rewinds.

_guide_help: A-17: how each class plays, shown on the creation screen and in the Character window (Classes.cs ClassDef.Guide): role (its job in a fight), weapon (what it fights with), resource (what its skills cost and how it comes back), signature (its defining skills and what they do), tree (its skill tree path and advanced form), tip (one line of advice for a new hero).

warrior.role: Front-line tank. Stands between the monsters and everyone else and takes the blows.
warrior.weapon: One-handed sword and a shield. Hold Guard to block; block at the last moment to parry.
warrior.resource: Stamina for swings, blocks and weapon skills; a little mana for Firebolt and Healing Light.
warrior.signature: Cleave (a wide swing), Shield Bash (stuns), Challenging Roar (every foe nearby turns on you).
warrior.tree: Warrior path, then Warlord: cleaving power attacks.
warrior.tip: Roar first, then Shield Bash the biggest foe. Your shield is your health bar.

rogue.role: Ranged damage dealer. Fast and fragile: kills from a distance and keeps moving.
rogue.weapon: Bow. Tap for quick shots, the heavy attack for a piercing power shot.
rogue.resource: Stamina for shots and bow skills; it refills quickly when you stop shooting.
rogue.signature: Volley (a fan of arrows), Rain of Arrows (an area that keeps hitting).
rogue.tree: Ranger path, then Sharpshooter: arrows that pierce everything.
rogue.tip: Roll away when something reaches you. Rain of Arrows on a doorway holds a whole pack.

mage.role: Ranged spell damage and crowd control. The widest choice of elements.
mage.weapon: Wand: quick magic bolts that cost a little mana.
mage.resource: Mana. It refills slowly by itself; Magic and mana potions are your fuel.
mage.signature: Firebolt (burns), Frost Nova (freezes everything around you), Chain Lightning (leaps between foes).
mage.tree: Mage path, then Archmage: stronger and wider spells.
mage.tip: Frost Nova when they reach you, then step back and burn them. Try Spellcraft early.

paladin.role: Holy tank and off-healer. Sturdy, with heals and the power to raise fallen friends.
paladin.resource: Stamina for the mace and shield, mana for holy spells.
paladin.signature: Smite (a pillar of light), Consecrate (holy ground that harms foes), Healing Light, Resurrect.
paladin.tree: Paladin path, then Crusader: judgement on every blow.
paladin.tip: Fight on your Consecrate. Holy damage is strongest against creatures of the Shadow.

berserker.role: Melee damage dealer who hits harder the more hurt he is.
berserker.weapon: Two-handed greatsword: slow, wide, heavy swings. No shield.
berserker.resource: Stamina for swings and skills. Rage is not a bar: it is the health you are missing.
berserker.signature: Whirlwind (spin through a pack), Leap (jump onto foes), War Cry (a damage buff).
berserker.tree: Berserker path, then Juggernaut: unstoppable fury.
berserker.tip: Low health makes you deadly, not safe. Life steal from the tree keeps you standing.

assassin.role: Burst damage. Critical hits, poison and getting behind the target.
assassin.weapon: Dagger: the fastest swings in the game, cheap on stamina.
assassin.signature: Shadow Step (appear behind a foe with a guaranteed crit), Venom Blade (every hit poisons for 10 s), Fan of Knives.
assassin.tree: Assassin path, then Shadowblade: huge crits and a shade's form.
assassin.tip: Shadow Step in, empty your stamina, roll out. Do not trade blows.

spellblade.role: Hybrid melee and magic. Magic adds damage to every sword swing.
spellblade.resource: Both bars: stamina for the sword, mana for spells. Put points in Strength and Magic.
spellblade.signature: Arcane Strike (a blow charged with lightning that arcs to two more foes), Cleave, Firebolt, Chain Lightning.
spellblade.tree: Spellblade path, then Runelord: the sword becomes a spell.
spellblade.tip: Open with a spell while they run at you, finish with the sword.

cleric.role: The best healer, with steady holy damage. The heart of a party.
cleric.weapon: Mace (with a touch of spell power).
cleric.resource: Mana for heals and holy spells.
cleric.signature: Healing Light, Smite, Consecrate, Frost Nova to keep foes off you, Resurrect.
cleric.tree: Cleric path, then High Priest: the strongest healing there is.
cleric.tip: Alone, stand on Consecrate and Smite. In a party, watch the health bars, not the monsters.

druid.role: Nature caster: poison over time, thorns that hurt attackers, regrowth, and animal forms.
druid.weapon: Staff: slow, heavy magic bolts that explode.
druid.signature: Thorn Volley (poisoning thorns), Entangle (roots foes in place), Healing Light. The Druid path teaches the Wolf and Boar forms.
druid.tree: Druid path, then Archdruid: stronger forms and wings.
druid.tip: Root them, poison them, and let the thorns do the rest. Take Call of the Pack early for the Wolf form.

necromancer.role: Shadow caster who drains life: the damage you deal heals you.
necromancer.resource: Mana, and your own life steal to stay alive.
necromancer.signature: Shadow Bolt, Life Drain (40% of its damage heals you), Frost Nova.
necromancer.tree: Necromancer path, then Lich Lord: a wraith's form and more drain.
necromancer.tip: Keep Life Drain on cooldown. You heal by killing.

warlock.role: Curses and damage over time. Statuses last longer on your foes.
warlock.signature: Hex (a cursed area: foes inside take 20% more damage and are poisoned), Shadow Bolt, Firebolt, Life Drain.
warlock.tree: Warlock path, then Doomcaller: afflictions that do not end.
warlock.tip: Curse the ground, burn what stands in it, and move on to the next pack while they wither.

lancer.role: Mobile melee with the longest reach. Knocks foes back and launches them.
lancer.signature: Lunge (dash through a line of foes), Leap, Cleave.
lancer.tree: Lancer path, then Dragoon: longer reach and harder landings.
lancer.tip: Fight at the tip of the spear: they cannot reach you where you can reach them.

warden.role: Tank that bleeds foes and cannot be moved. More health than any other class.
warden.signature: War Cry (weakens foes, strengthens you), Shield Bash, Challenging Roar, Cleave. Your hits cause bleeding.
warden.tree: Warden path, then Ironclad: a walking wall.
warden.tip: You win long fights. Roar, block, and let the bleeds tick.

monk.role: Unarmed melee: very fast strikes, dodging instead of armor.
monk.weapon: Bare fists (hand wraps). Fists use little stamina and swing fastest.
monk.resource: Stamina for strikes; chi skills use mana, which refills quicker for you.
monk.signature: Palm Strike (blasts a foe back), Cyclone Kick (all around), Chi Wave, Flying Crane (a leaping kick), Inner Peace (heals 30%), Iron Body (a shield, and no stuns).
monk.tree: Monk path, then Grandmaster: fists that need no weapon.
monk.tip: Keep hitting: attack speed is your damage. Iron Body before a boss's big blow.

bard.role: Support caster: songs that strengthen the whole party, sound that harms and lulls foes.
bard.signature: Sonic Riff (damage), Discord (weakens), Lullaby (an area where foes slow to a crawl, then freeze), Ballad of Heroes (party buff), Mending Verse (party heal).
bard.tree: Bard path, then Maestro: faster, wider songs.
bard.tip: Sing Ballad of Heroes before the pull. Alone, Lullaby the pack and fight one at a time.

shaman.role: Elemental support: totems that fight for you, lightning and lava, healing water, spirit forms.
shaman.signature: Storm Totem (a turret), Lava Burst, Earth Shock (tosses foes and sunders their armor), Healing Spring, Windfury. The Shaman path teaches the Wisp and Ember Spirit forms.
shaman.tree: Shaman path, then Stormcaller: lightning that keeps leaping, a stone spirit's form.
shaman.tip: Drop the totem first; it keeps working while you cast.

samurai.role: Precise melee: critical cuts, quick draws, and a will that shrugs off stuns.
samurai.signature: Iaido (a dash-cut that always crits), Crescent Slash, Wind Scythe (a ranged cut), Kiai (a shout), Thousand Cuts.
samurai.tree: Samurai path, then Kensei: one perfect cut.
samurai.tip: Iaido through the pack, turn, cut. Critical damage is your best stat.

chronomancer.role: Control caster: slows, stops and rewinds time. Skills come back faster than anyone's.
chronomancer.resource: Mana, with shorter cooldowns than other casters.
chronomancer.signature: Chrono Bolt (slows), Rewind (turns your wounds back: heals 40% of your health), Accelerate (haste), Stasis (freezes a foe in time), Temporal Rift (drags foes in).
chronomancer.tree: Chronomancer path, then Timelord: everything ready sooner.
chronomancer.tip: Rewind is your second life: use it after the big hit, not before. Stasis buys the time to cast.

_spells_note: Legacy list; skills now live in data/skills.json.
